cues.text: Outside Port Island Station, by a fountain and a bench, a man in a suit stands facing you among the passers-by, smiling.
The man steps up to you and hands you a business card.
President Tanaka turns his back on you, walks a few steps toward the fountain and stops there, his back still to you.
Tanaka turns around and starts at the sight of you, still standing there. Then he stomps right up to you, glaring.
